annotations.title: Autonomous Web HTML to Clean LLM-Optimized Markdown Engine

description: Converts raw HTML pages into clean, boilerplate-free, LLM-optimized Markdown with preserved hyperlinks and headings. Use when ingesting raw web documents or blog posts into agent context windows; for isolating tabular data into structured datasets, use parse_html_tables instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('conversion_mode' defaults to 'clean_semantic_article'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

conversion_mode.description: Markdown extraction strategy: clean semantic article, preserve tables/code, or minimal text.

html_content.description: Raw HTML string of the web page or document to convert to clean Markdown.

preserve_links.description: Whether to retain anchor hyperlinks and image markdown references in output.

name: extract_clean_markdown

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for extract_clean_markdown.

title.description: Document title extracted from H1 or title tag.

word_count.description: Net word count of extracted readable prose.

title: Autonomous Web HTML to Clean LLM-Optimized Markdown Engine
